reasons.name: I ordered it by mistake or no longer need it
reasons.help_text: Eligible items may be refunded after review and return-condition checks.

reasons.name: I received the wrong item
reasons.help_text: Upload a photo showing the received item, SKU, or packaging label.

reasons.name: The product is defective or failed during normal use
reasons.help_text: Upload a clear photo of the product and the problem. We will advise whether it must be returned.

reasons.name: The item arrived damaged
reasons.help_text: Upload clear photos of the item and its packaging.
